cards.audioText: N: [Your call sign is ACA121, you are 6 miles from touchdown, your fuel warning light is on, call Wuhan approach for ILS approach and priority landing.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是加航121，你现在距离接地点6海里，你的燃油告警灯亮了，呼叫武汉进近，请求盲降进近，优先着陆。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, ACA121, 6 miles from touchdown, our fuel warning light is on, request priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，加航121，接地点6海里，我们的燃油告警灯亮了，请求优先着陆。

cards.audioText: C: ACA121, Wuhan approach, roger, cleared ILS approach runway 36R and turn right heading 300 to final. You are 5 and half miles from touchdown.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航121，武汉进近，收到，可以盲降进近跑道36右，右转航向300加入五边，你现在距离接地点5.5海里。
cards.referenceText: Cleared ILS approach runway 36R and turn right heading 300 to final, ACA121.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以盲降进近跑道36右，右转航向300加入五边，加航121。

cards.audioText: C: ACA121, turn right to 310 to intercept the localizer, contact 118.7 for Tower, good day.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航121，右转航向310，截获航向道，联系塔台118.7，再见。
cards.referenceText: Turn right to 310 to intercept the localizer, 118.7, good day, ACA121.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向310，截获航向道，联系塔台118.7，再见，加航121。

cards.audioText: N: [Contact Wuhan Tower, you are approaching AKO, level 1100 meters.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【联系武汉塔台， 你正在接近AKO，在1100米平飞。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA121, approaching AKO, level at 1100m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，加航121，接近AKO，在1100米平飞。

cards.audioText:
C: ACA121, Wuhan Tower, for your information, there is lighting maintenance in progress near the end of runway.
N:[ You ask if ILS CAT II is available.]
cards.audioTextZh:
加航121，武汉塔台，跑道头有灯光系统维修工作。
【询问二类盲降是否可用。】
cards.referenceText: Confirm if ILS category II available? ACA121.
cards.referenceTextZh: 证实二类盲降是否可用，加航121。

cards.audioText: C: ACA121, Wuhan Tower, ILS CAT II is unserviceable due to the inoperative center line lighting; ILS CAT I minimum is effective.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航121，武汉塔台，由于跑道中线灯光系统故障，二类盲降不可用，一类盲降最低标准生效。

cards.audioText: C: ACA121, runway is covered with patches of ice, braking action is poor.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航121，跑道道面有积冰，刹车性能差。
cards.referenceText: Roger, braking action is poor, ACA121.

cards.audioText: N: [You request to dim the approach lights to grade 3. They look too bright from your aircraft.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你请求将进近灯调整到3级，从你飞机上看太亮了。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA121, request to dim the approach lights to grade 3. They look too bright.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，加航121，请求将进近灯调暗至3级，它们太亮了。

cards.audioText:
C: Roger.
C: ACA121, check gear down and you are cleared to land.
cards.audioTextZh:
收到。
加航121，检查起落架放下，可以落地。
cards.referenceText: Check gear down and cleared to land, ACA121.
cards.referenceTextZh: 检查起落架放下，可以落地，加航121。

cards.audioText: N: [You have three green lights. The PAPI (PAPI precision approach path indicator) appears to be a little bit low but actually your aircraft is high on the glide path. Report to the Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你看到了3个绿灯，PAPI灯（精密进近航道指示器）看起来有点低，但是实际上你的飞机在下滑道上方，告知塔台管制员。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA121, we have 3 green, the PAPI seems to be a little bit low but our aircraft is actually high on the glide path.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，加航121，我们看到3个绿灯，PAPI灯看起来有点低，但是实际上我们的飞机在下滑道以上。

cards.audioText: C: ACA121, Wuhan Tower, look at the whole airfield and adjust your descent rate.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航121，武汉塔台，看下整个机场，调整你的下降率。
cards.referenceText: Look at the whole airfield and adjust descent rate, ACA121.
cards.referenceTextZh: 看下整个机场，调整下降率，加航121。

cards.audioText: N: [You tell controller you're overshooting, your altitude is too high.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【告知管制员，你复飞了，你的高度太高了。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA121, going around, our altitude is too high.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，加航121，我们复飞了，我们的高度太高了。

cards.audioText: C: ACA121, check your aircraft condition in the holding area. Contact Departure on 119.9
cards.audioTextZh: 加航121，在等待区域检查飞机状态，联系离场119.9。

cards.audioText: C: ACA121, confirm you are overshooting.

C: Roger, sir, what's your intention.
N: [Tell departure you want to circle back for another landing on runway 36R.]
cards.audioTextZh:
收到，你的意图是什么？
【告知离场，你想盘旋进近跑道36右再次降落。】
cards.referenceText: Request circle back for another landing on runway 36R, ACA121.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求盘旋进近跑道36右再次降落，加航121。

cards.audioText: C: ACA121, I am sorry to inform you that runway 36R is closed. There are patches of snow and much debris on the runway. Use runway 04 instead. Fly heading 134 to intercept Localizer of runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航121，抱歉通知，跑道36右关闭了，跑道上有雪块和许多碎屑。使用跑道04，航向134切跑道04航向道。
cards.referenceText: Runway 04, fly heading 134 to intercept Localizer of runway 04, ACA121.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道04，航向134切跑道04航向道，加航121。

cards.audioText: C: ACA121, the wind is northwest about 10 to 15. Turn left heading 070 and descends to 1200 meters, QNH 1001.
cards.referenceText: Turning left heading 070 and descends to 1200m, QNH1001, ACA121.

cards.audioText:
C: ACA121, what is the status of your aircraft?
N: [Tell the controller your aircraft is in good condition, but this time you don’t have enough fuel for another missed approach. You want a successful landing this time.]
cards.audioTextZh:
加航121，飞机目前的状态如何？
【告知管制员，你飞机状态良好，但这次，你没有足够的燃油来再次进近，你这次想成功着陆。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, ACA121, unable another missed approach due fuel shortage, request to land this time.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，加航121，由于燃油短缺，无法再次进近，请求着陆。
